name: Cheercrate Store (AI dropshipping)
goal: Grow a frizz-free hair TikTok audience with honest, useful posts, then turn it into sales of products whose samples have been tested, on the Cheercrate Shopify store.
headline: posts_ready
posts_published
tiktok_followers
store_sessions_30d
orders_90d
conversion_rate_30d

nodes.label: Spot trends
nodes.does: Finds hair/frizz topics, hooks and formats doing well on UK TikTok now, with links as evidence

nodes.label: Make posts
nodes.does: Writes carousel slides + caption into make_posts.py and content-plan.md; loops until rubric passes

nodes.label: Render slides
nodes.does: Renders PNG slides + MP4 on George's PC (needs the Windows fonts)

nodes.label: Schedule
nodes.does: Places posts into schedule.md slots (Sprout UK windows, later the account's own peak hours)

nodes.label: George posts
nodes.does: Uploads in TikTok with a trending sound. Posting stays manual.

nodes.label: Write listings
nodes.does: Writes honest Shopify product copy from the verified sample notes; loops until rubric passes

nodes.label: George publishes
nodes.does: Approves copy, price and going live. No ad spend without George.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.does: Post stats 72h after posting (views, saves, follows) + Shopify sessions, conversion, orders

nodes.label: Self-improve
nodes.does: A/B tests one change to the content or listing instructions, judged on saves per 1,000 views or conversion

notes: All 3 products are ACTIVE with 0 stock before any sample has been checked. supplier-shortlist.md says to verify the samples (plug, heat, magnet strength) and the UKCA/CE paperwork first. George should decide whether they stay live.
51 store sessions and a 0% conversion rate in the last 30 days, and 1 order in 90 days. The store isn't ready for ads yet, so there's no ads node until a product is verified.
TikTok post stats aren't in any connector. The analyst reads TikTok Studio in the browser on George's PC, or George pastes the numbers in.
Apify's free monthly credit is used up until it resets, so trend research uses web search for now.
